scripts.dev: npm run build:contracts && concurrently -k -n api,web,contracts -c cyan,green,gray "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:web" "npm run dev -w @game-creator/contracts"
scripts.build: npm run build:contracts && npm run build -w @game-creator/api && npm run build -w @game-creator/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:contracts && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present && tsc -p tsconfig.tools.json
scripts.test:advanced: npm run build:contracts && vitest run -c vitest.advanced.config.ts
scripts.test:all: npm run test && npm run test:advanced
scripts.sandbox:build: npm run build && docker build -f deploy/sandbox/Dockerfile -t gamecreator-sandbox:pw1.60.0 .
scripts.test:sandbox: npm run build:contracts && vitest run apps/api/test/sandbox-integration.test.ts
